newsitem.title: GABON: Zaire's Mobutu leaves Gabon for Kinshasa - aides.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu leaves Gabon for Kinshasa - aides.

text.p: Zaire's ailing and embattled President Mobutu Sese Seko left Gabon by plane, witnesses said on Saturday, and aides said he was returning to the Zairean capital Kinshasa.
Witnesses said Mobutu walked up a red carpet into the presidential Boeing 727 plane at the airport in Gabon's capital Libreville at 12.45 p.m. (1145 GMT). The plane took off soon afterwards.
"He is certainly returning to Kinshasa," one of his aides said earlier.

South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki said he expected Mobutu to return to Zaire after he agreed to further face-to-face talks with rebel leader Laurent Kabila, which are to be held on Wednesday.
